create.title: Samee imtixaan
create.description: Warqadda si toos ah ayaa loo diyaarinayaa, iyadoo ay ku jiraan dhammaan ardayda firfircoon ee fasalka la doortay.
create.detailsDescription: Geli magaca, nooca iyo maaddooyinka imtixaankan.
create.noClasses: Weli laguuma qoondayn wax fasal ah.

create.noSubjects: Weli maaddo ma jirto. Hoos ku dar mid.
